uniform_results.regular_binary_forms: For r>a>=1, coprime degree-a binary Q,H have the exact regular-core rank sum (B3) at complete tiers, all fields; characteristic dependence is retained.
uniform_results.noncoprime_bracket: For all nonzero degree-a Q,H their seed ranks lie between the explicit canonical and regular binomial sums.
uniform_results.original_integral_decomposition: For the coefficient-one quadratic pair the seed prefix lattices split into G_s, two G_(s-1), and G_(s-2), including ambient free lattices.
uniform_results.finite_block_query: At exact rational prices: O_a(s^3*(1+s/r)^2) field operations, O_a(s^2) additional rational arithmetic/floor operations, and O_a((1+s/r)^2) field elements of scratch space; binomial generation and bit costs separate.
uniform_results.sufficient_remaining_identity: (B8), equality of regular/canonical core ranks at every coherent cutoff with 0<u<Z.
uniform_results.identity_equivalence: Uniform original regular/canonical seed equality is equivalent to (B8), by inverting the finite homogeneous-channel convolution.
uniform_results.conditional_consequence: For a=2, (B8) would transfer every remaining original largest-z cone and give a uniform full-family O(n) bound.
